home.intro:
We are a theoretical and observational cosmology research group based in the Department of Physics at FCEN, UBA.

Our work connects models of the early universe with data from large-scale surveys, exploring the nature of dark matter, dark energy, and the large-scale structure of the cosmos.
home.highlight1Body: We study primordial fluctuations and their evolution into the structures we observe today.
home.highlight2Body: Our latest work analyses cosmological constraints from weak gravitational lensing data.
home.highlight3Body: We actively participate in public science communication activities at the national level.

research.title: Research
research.intro: We address fundamental questions about the structure and evolution of the universe using theoretical tools and observational data analysis. Our active research lines span perturbation cosmology, dark matter, dark energy, and large-scale structure formation.

publications.title: Publications
publications.footnote: Publications are sourced from InspireHEP, arXiv, and ORCID. When the same paper is indexed by more than one source, entries are merged by DOI into a single record (precedence: InspireHEP, then ORCID, then arXiv).

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.intro: We believe in the importance of bringing science closer to society. We participate in talks, workshops, and outreach publications aimed at broad audiences and the educational community.
